2350-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Stone Calendar, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-4268-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4268-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2275-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2275-8192.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2527-3143-3464-3899.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-3899.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

1445-1913-4871-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5231-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=2 that is colorless and enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it

2034-5660-6854--36.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with MV<=2 if it doesn't have {X} in its mana cost, or enough to cast it with X=1 otherwise.
2034-5660-6854--36.description:
Cast the creature from your hand by paying {2} or less, causing the creature to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
If the creature can be cast for {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may cast that creature for an arbitrarily large amount of mana if it has {X} in its mana cost.

225-851-2557-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1274-4186-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

777-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

1017-1494-3017-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1849-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2034-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1402-2644-4763-7060.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

645-1267-2292-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2292-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-969-3292-3892.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-969-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-725-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-725-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

3923-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
3923-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Mystic Speculation spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

2743-4493-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
2743-4493-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Irenicus's Vile Duplication twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Irenicus's Vile Duplications, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

880-4826-6528.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4826-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1887-2793-5089-5666-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with the persist creature

1856-5686-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1856-5686-6249--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

856-1808-2034-4321.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1447-2719-3967.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

659-969-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-969-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

2452-3249-4210-5670--56.notablePrerequisites:
Pious Evangel can be on the battlefield transformed.
Your life total is at least 2 if Wayward Disciple is on the battlefield.
2452-3249-4210-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it is on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4166-4613-4968.notablePrerequisites: Ob Nixilis has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4166-4613-4968.description:
Activate Ob Nixilis using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat.

948-2060-2433-2486-3334.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-2486-3334.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Ooze creature token, which will enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters due to Lae'zel and Master Chef.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Lae'zel.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1530-2334-2928-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-2334-2928-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

336-1170-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an enchantment spell using Muldrotha this turn.
336-1170-5131.description:
Activate Gaea's Touch by sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Gaea's Touch from your graveyard by paying {G}{G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

914-1980-2493-3130.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1980-2493-3130.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Archaeomancer and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

1636-1785-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1785-4484.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Ebondeath enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1271-2575-3212.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Temporal Mastery on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Temporal Mastery, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
